title: Pipestem McKeever Lodge HVAC Replacement
overview: The original HVAC piping at the 63,000 SF McKeever Lodge had corroded past its lifespan, with leaks that once knocked out electrical service. MEI replaced all ~4,000 linear feet of piping in phases to keep guest rooms in service, and interconnected the lodge's two boiler/chiller plants so one could run the whole lodge while the other was rebuilt — also providing redundancy against an outage.
